"""Real controller reconciliation contracts; no Pod status is forged."""
import copy,json,pathlib,secrets,time,urllib.parse
import support
from controllers import ControllerCluster
from support import token,student,grant,configmap,pod,kubeconfig

support.Cluster=ControllerCluster


class Session(support.Session):
    def __enter__(self):
        super().__enter__()
        try:self.c.start_controllers()
        except BaseException:self.c.close();raise
        print('NATIVE_FIXTURE_READY:batch3-kubernetes-controllers',flush=True)
        return self


def get(c,path):
    code,obj=c.request('GET',path)
    assert code==200,(path,code,obj)
    return obj


def objects(c,ns,resource='pods',group='/api/v1'):
    return get(c,f'{group}/namespaces/{ns}/{resource}')['items']


def controller_uid(obj):
    return next((r['uid'] for r in obj['metadata'].get('ownerReferences',[]) if r.get('controller')),None)


def rs(c,ns,name=None,replicas=1,app=None,image='invalid.local/not-run:v1'):
    app=app or token('app');name=name or token('rs')
    return c.create(f'/apis/apps/v1/namespaces/{ns}/replicasets',{'apiVersion':'apps/v1','kind':'ReplicaSet','metadata':{'name':name},'spec':{'replicas':replicas,'selector':{'matchLabels':{'app':app}},'template':{'metadata':{'labels':{'app':app}},'spec':{'containers':[{'name':'main','image':image,'env':[{'name':'PRESERVE','value':token('env')}]}]}}}})


def deployment(c,ns,replicas=1,app=None):
    app=app or token('app')
    return c.create(f'/apis/apps/v1/namespaces/{ns}/deployments',{'apiVersion':'apps/v1','kind':'Deployment','metadata':{'name':token('deployment')},'spec':{'replicas':replicas,'selector':{'matchLabels':{'app':app}},'template':{'metadata':{'labels':{'app':app}},'spec':{'containers':[{'name':'main','image':'invalid.local/not-run:v1','env':[{'name':'PRESERVE','value':token('env')}]}]}}}})


def owned_pods(c,ns,uid,count):
    def found():
        result=[p for p in objects(c,ns) if controller_uid(p)==uid and not p['metadata'].get('deletionTimestamp')]
        return result if len(result)==count else False
    return c.wait_controller(found,12,'real ReplicaSet-created/adopted Pods')


def deployment_rs(c,ns,uid):
    def found():
        result=[r for r in objects(c,ns,'replicasets','/apis/apps/v1') if controller_uid(r)==uid]
        return result if result else False
    return c.wait_controller(found,12,'real Deployment-created ReplicaSet')


def pv(c,name,labels,modes=('ReadWriteOnce',),claim=None,path=None):
    spec={'capacity':{'storage':'16Mi'},'accessModes':list(modes),'persistentVolumeReclaimPolicy':'Retain','storageClassName':'','hostPath':{'path':str(path or c.root/('data-'+name)),'type':'DirectoryOrCreate'}}
    if claim:spec['claimRef']={'namespace':claim[0],'name':claim[1]}
    return c.create('/api/v1/persistentvolumes',{'apiVersion':'v1','kind':'PersistentVolume','metadata':{'name':name,'labels':labels},'spec':spec})


def bound(c,ns,name):
    path=f'/api/v1/namespaces/{ns}/persistentvolumeclaims/{name}'
    def ready():
        code,obj=c.request('GET',path)
        return obj if code==200 and obj.get('status',{}).get('phase')=='Bound' else False
    return c.wait_controller(ready,12,'native persistentvolume binder Bound')


def check_recreate():
    with Session() as s:
        dep=deployment(s.c,s.ns);replica=deployment_rs(s.c,s.ns,dep['metadata']['uid'])[0]
        managed=owned_pods(s.c,s.ns,replica['metadata']['uid'],1)[0]
        bare=pod(s.c,s.ns)
        cases={'bare_path':f'/api/v1/namespaces/{s.ns}/pods/'+bare['metadata']['name'],'bare_uid':bare['metadata']['uid'],'managed_path':f'/api/v1/namespaces/{s.ns}/pods/'+managed['metadata']['name'],'managed_uid':managed['metadata']['uid']}
        result=student()(s.api,cases)
        assert result is True and s.c.request('GET',cases['bare_path'])[0]==404
        replacement=owned_pods(s.c,s.ns,replica['metadata']['uid'],1)[0]
        assert replacement['metadata']['uid']!=managed['metadata']['uid']
        assert replacement['spec']==managed['spec']
        assert s.c.request('GET',cases['bare_path'])[0]==404
        assert get(s.c,f'/apis/apps/v1/namespaces/{s.ns}/deployments/'+dep['metadata']['name'])['metadata']['uid']==dep['metadata']['uid']
        assert all(x['method']=='DELETE' for x in s.trace) and len(s.trace)==2


def check_adoption():
    with Session() as s:
        for count in (1,2):
            app=token('shared');foreign_dep=deployment(s.c,s.ns,app=app)
            foreign_rs=deployment_rs(s.c,s.ns,foreign_dep['metadata']['uid'])[0]
            foreign=owned_pods(s.c,s.ns,foreign_rs['metadata']['uid'],1)[0]
            orphans=[s.c.create(f'/api/v1/namespaces/{s.ns}/pods',{'apiVersion':'v1','kind':'Pod','metadata':{'name':token('orphan'),'labels':{'app':app}},'spec':{'containers':[{'name':'main','image':'invalid.local/not-run:v1'}]}}) for _ in range(count)]
            name=token('adopter')
            result=student()(s.api,{'namespace':s.ns,'name':name,'app':app,'replicas':count,'image':'invalid.local/not-run:v1'})
            adopter=get(s.c,f'/apis/apps/v1/namespaces/{s.ns}/replicasets/{name}')
            assert result==adopter['metadata']['uid']
            assert adopter['spec']['replicas']==count and adopter['spec']['selector']['matchLabels']=={'app':app}
            adopted=owned_pods(s.c,s.ns,adopter['metadata']['uid'],count)
            assert {x['metadata']['uid']:x['spec'] for x in adopted}=={x['metadata']['uid']:x['spec'] for x in orphans},'must adopt original eligible Pods, not create replacements'
            original_foreign=get(s.c,f'/api/v1/namespaces/{s.ns}/pods/'+foreign['metadata']['name'])
            assert original_foreign['metadata']['uid']==foreign['metadata']['uid'] and controller_uid(original_foreign)==foreign_rs['metadata']['uid']


def check_orphan():
    with Session() as s:
        parent=rs(s.c,s.ns,replicas=2);original=owned_pods(s.c,s.ns,parent['metadata']['uid'],2)
        path=f'/apis/apps/v1/namespaces/{s.ns}/replicasets/'+parent['metadata']['name']
        result=student()(s.api,{'path':path,'uid':parent['metadata']['uid']})
        assert result is True
        s.c.wait_controller(lambda:s.c.request('GET',path)[0]==404,12,'native orphan deletion of ReplicaSet')
        for previous in original:
            code,current=s.c.request('GET',f'/api/v1/namespaces/{s.ns}/pods/'+previous['metadata']['name'])
            assert code==200 and current['metadata']['uid']==previous['metadata']['uid'],'orphan policy must preserve original Pods'
            assert controller_uid(current) is None and current['spec']==previous['spec']
        assert s.trace and s.trace[0]['method']=='DELETE'


def check_create_deployment():
    with Session() as s:
        config=s.c.root/'kubectl-private.json';kubeconfig(s.c,config,s.ns,context='private-operation')
        before=config.read_bytes();name=token('web');replicas=secrets.randbelow(3)+1
        uid=student()(s.runner,{'config':str(config),'context':'private-operation','namespace':s.ns,'name':name,'replicas':replicas,'image':'invalid.local/create-demo:v1'})
        dep=get(s.c,f'/apis/apps/v1/namespaces/{s.ns}/deployments/{name}')
        assert uid==dep['metadata']['uid'] and dep['spec']['replicas']==replicas
        child=deployment_rs(s.c,s.ns,uid)[0];pods=owned_pods(s.c,s.ns,child['metadata']['uid'],replicas)
        assert all(p['spec']['containers'][0]['image']=='invalid.local/create-demo:v1' for p in pods)
        assert all(p.get('status',{}).get('phase')=='Pending' for p in pods)
        assert config.read_bytes()==before and any('create' in r.get('args',[]) and 'deployment' in r['args'] for r in s.trace)


def check_counts():
    with Session() as s:
        count=secrets.randbelow(3)+2;parent=rs(s.c,s.ns,replicas=count)
        pods=owned_pods(s.c,s.ns,parent['metadata']['uid'],count)
        path=f'/apis/apps/v1/namespaces/{s.ns}/replicasets/'+parent['metadata']['name']
        s.c.wait_controller(lambda:get(s.c,path).get('status',{}).get('replicas')==count,12,'ReplicaSet native status reconciliation')
        result=student()(s.api,{'path':path,'pods_path':f'/api/v1/namespaces/{s.ns}/pods','owner_uid':parent['metadata']['uid']})
        assert result=={'desired':count,'current':count,'ready':0,'business_healthy':False}
        assert len(s.trace)>=2 and all(r['method']=='GET' for r in s.trace)
        assert all(p.get('status',{}).get('phase')=='Pending' for p in pods)


def check_revision():
    with Session() as s:
        dep=deployment(s.c,s.ns);old_rs=deployment_rs(s.c,s.ns,dep['metadata']['uid'])[0]
        owned_pods(s.c,s.ns,old_rs['metadata']['uid'],1)
        direct=rs(s.c,s.ns);direct_pod=owned_pods(s.c,s.ns,direct['metadata']['uid'],1)[0]
        dep_path=f'/apis/apps/v1/namespaces/{s.ns}/deployments/'+dep['metadata']['name']
        rs_path=f'/apis/apps/v1/namespaces/{s.ns}/replicasets/'+direct['metadata']['name']
        image='invalid.local/new-template:'+secrets.token_hex(4)
        result=student()(s.api,{'deployment':dep_path,'replicaset':rs_path,'image':image})
        assert result is True
        assert get(s.c,dep_path)['spec']['template']['spec']['containers'][0]['image']==image
        assert get(s.c,rs_path)['spec']['template']['spec']['containers'][0]['image']==image
        assert get(s.c,dep_path)['spec']['replicas']==dep['spec']['replicas'] and get(s.c,rs_path)['spec']['replicas']==direct['spec']['replicas'],'only change the template image, not replica counts'
        def revised():
            candidates=deployment_rs(s.c,s.ns,dep['metadata']['uid'])
            return next((x for x in candidates if x['metadata']['uid']!=old_rs['metadata']['uid'] and x['spec']['template']['spec']['containers'][0]['image']==image),False)
        new_rs=s.c.wait_controller(revised,12,'real Deployment new revision')
        new_pods=owned_pods(s.c,s.ns,new_rs['metadata']['uid'],1)
        assert new_pods[0]['spec']['containers'][0]['image']==image
        current=owned_pods(s.c,s.ns,direct['metadata']['uid'],1)[0]
        assert current['metadata']['uid']==direct_pod['metadata']['uid'] and current['spec']==direct_pod['spec'],'changing an RS template must not silently replace existing Pods'
        assert any(e['metadata']['annotations'].get('deployment.kubernetes.io/revision')=='2' for e in deployment_rs(s.c,s.ns,dep['metadata']['uid']))
        assert all('/pods/' not in r['path'] for r in s.trace),'do not manually replace Pods to simulate controller behavior'


def check_pvc():
    with Session() as s:
        name=token('claim');volume=token('pv')
        target=pv(s.c,volume,{'training':'private'},claim=(s.ns,name))
        request=str(secrets.randbelow(10)+2)+'Mi'
        uid=student()(s.api,{'namespace':s.ns,'name':name,'volume':volume,'request':request,'modes':['ReadWriteOnce']})
        submitted=get(s.c,f'/api/v1/namespaces/{s.ns}/persistentvolumeclaims/{name}')
        assert submitted['spec']['volumeName']==volume and submitted['spec']['resources']['requests']['storage']==request
        assert submitted['spec']['accessModes']==['ReadWriteOnce']
        claim=bound(s.c,s.ns,name)
        assert uid==claim['metadata']['uid'] and claim['spec']['volumeName']==volume
        actual=get(s.c,'/api/v1/persistentvolumes/'+volume)
        assert actual['status']['phase']=='Bound' and actual['spec']['claimRef']['uid']==uid
        assert actual['metadata']['uid']==target['metadata']['uid'] and claim['spec']['storageClassName']==''


def check_modes():
    with Session() as s:
        for mode in ('ReadWriteMany','ReadOnlyMany'):
            selector=token('pool');wrong=pv(s.c,token('rwo'),{'pool':selector})
            correct=pv(s.c,token('compatible'),{'pool':selector},modes=(mode,))
            name=token('claim');request=str(secrets.randbelow(10)+2)+'Mi'
            uid=student()(s.api,{'namespace':s.ns,'name':name,'selector':selector,'modes':[mode],'request':request})
            submitted=get(s.c,f'/api/v1/namespaces/{s.ns}/persistentvolumeclaims/{name}')
            assert submitted['spec']['accessModes']==[mode] and submitted['spec']['resources']['requests']['storage']==request
            claim=bound(s.c,s.ns,name)
            assert uid==claim['metadata']['uid'] and claim['spec']['volumeName']==correct['metadata']['name']
            untouched=get(s.c,'/api/v1/persistentvolumes/'+wrong['metadata']['name'])
            assert untouched['spec']==wrong['spec'] and not untouched['spec'].get('claimRef')
        print('NATIVE_BINDER_ACCESS_MODE_COMPATIBILITY; NO_MOUNT_OR_IO_ISOLATION_CLAIM')


def check_retain():
    with Session() as s:
        data=s.c.root/'retained-data';data.mkdir();marker=data/'payload';payload=secrets.token_bytes(61);marker.write_bytes(payload)
        claim_name=token('claim');volume=token('retained')
        target=pv(s.c,volume,{'owner':token('owner')},claim=(s.ns,claim_name),path=data)
        s.c.create(f'/api/v1/namespaces/{s.ns}/persistentvolumeclaims',{'apiVersion':'v1','kind':'PersistentVolumeClaim','metadata':{'name':claim_name},'spec':{'storageClassName':'','volumeName':volume,'accessModes':['ReadWriteOnce'],'resources':{'requests':{'storage':'8Mi'}}}})
        claim=bound(s.c,s.ns,claim_name)
        case={'path':f'/api/v1/namespaces/{s.ns}/persistentvolumeclaims/{claim_name}','uid':claim['metadata']['uid']}
        assert student()(s.api,case) is True
        assert len(s.trace)==1 and s.trace[0]['method']=='DELETE' and s.trace[0]['path']==case['path'] and s.trace[0]['status'] in (200,202),'must issue the actual UID-protected PVC delete'
        s.c.wait_controller(lambda:s.c.request('GET',case['path'])[0]==404,12,'PVC protection controller release')
        s.c.wait_controller(lambda:get(s.c,'/api/v1/persistentvolumes/'+volume).get('status',{}).get('phase')=='Released',12,'PV binder Retain release')
        current=get(s.c,'/api/v1/persistentvolumes/'+volume)
        assert current['metadata']['uid']==target['metadata']['uid'] and current['spec']['persistentVolumeReclaimPolicy']=='Retain'
        assert current['spec']['claimRef']['uid']==claim['metadata']['uid'],'do not clear old data ownership automatically'
        assert marker.read_bytes()==payload and len(s.trace)==1 and s.trace[0]['method']=='DELETE'


def check_ephemeral():
    with Session() as s:
        old=s.c.create(f'/api/v1/namespaces/{s.ns}/persistentvolumeclaims',{'apiVersion':'v1','kind':'PersistentVolumeClaim','metadata':{'name':token('unrelated')},'spec':{'storageClassName':'','accessModes':['ReadWriteOnce'],'resources':{'requests':{'storage':'1Mi'}}}})
        name=token('ephemeral');volume='scratch'
        document={'apiVersion':'v1','kind':'Pod','metadata':{'name':name},'spec':{'containers':[{'name':'main','image':'invalid.local/no-runtime','volumeMounts':[{'name':volume,'mountPath':'/scratch'}]}],'volumes':[{'name':volume,'ephemeral':{'volumeClaimTemplate':{'spec':{'storageClassName':'','accessModes':['ReadWriteOnce'],'resources':{'requests':{'storage':'1Mi'}}}}}}]}}
        obj=s.c.create(f'/api/v1/namespaces/{s.ns}/pods',document)
        claim_path=f'/api/v1/namespaces/{s.ns}/persistentvolumeclaims/{name}-{volume}'
        def created():
            code,value=s.c.request('GET',claim_path)
            return value if code==200 else False
        claim=s.c.wait_controller(created,12,'native ephemeral volume controller-created PVC')
        assert controller_uid(claim)==obj['metadata']['uid']
        path=f'/api/v1/namespaces/{s.ns}/pods/{name}'
        assert student()(s.api,{'path':path,'uid':obj['metadata']['uid']}) is True
        assert s.c.request('GET',path)[0]==404
        s.c.wait_controller(lambda:s.c.request('GET',claim_path)[0]==404,12,'native GC cleanup of generic ephemeral PVC')
        assert get(s.c,f'/api/v1/namespaces/{s.ns}/persistentvolumeclaims/'+old['metadata']['name'])['metadata']['uid']==old['metadata']['uid']
        assert len(s.trace)==1 and s.trace[0]['method']=='DELETE' and '/pods/' in s.trace[0]['path']


def check_quota():
    with Session() as s:
        qname=token('quota');path=f'/api/v1/namespaces/{s.ns}/resourcequotas/{qname}'
        quota=s.c.create(f'/api/v1/namespaces/{s.ns}/resourcequotas',{'apiVersion':'v1','kind':'ResourceQuota','metadata':{'name':qname},'spec':{'hard':{'count/configmaps':'1','count/secrets':'2'}}})
        s.c.wait_controller(lambda:get(s.c,path).get('status',{}).get('hard',{}).get('count/configmaps')=='1',12,'quota initial hard reconciliation')
        old=configmap(s.c,s.ns)
        request={'apiVersion':'v1','kind':'ConfigMap','metadata':{'name':token('new')},'data':{'value':token('payload')}}
        denied,_=s.c.request('POST',f'/api/v1/namespaces/{s.ns}/configmaps',request);assert denied==403
        limit=secrets.randbelow(3)+2
        result=student()(s.api,{'path':path,'collection':f'/api/v1/namespaces/{s.ns}/configmaps','document':request,'new_limit':str(limit)})
        assert result is True
        current=get(s.c,path);assert current['spec']['hard']=={'count/configmaps':str(limit),'count/secrets':'2'}
        assert get(s.c,f'/api/v1/namespaces/{s.ns}/configmaps/'+old['metadata']['name'])==old
        assert get(s.c,f'/api/v1/namespaces/{s.ns}/configmaps/'+request['metadata']['name'])['data']==request['data']
        s.c.wait_controller(lambda:get(s.c,path).get('status',{}).get('used',{}).get('count/configmaps')=='2',12,'quota actual used accounting')
        for _ in range(limit-2):configmap(s.c,s.ns)
        code,_=s.c.request('POST',f'/api/v1/namespaces/{s.ns}/configmaps',{'apiVersion':'v1','kind':'ConfigMap','metadata':{'name':token('must-deny')}})
        assert code==403,'new quota must remain enforced, not removed or bypassed'
        assert all('/status' not in x['path'] and x['method']!='DELETE' for x in s.trace)


def check_namespace_discovery():
    with Session() as s:
        namespace=token('terminating');s.c.namespace(namespace)
        group=token('removed')+'.example.com';registration='v1.'+group
        api_service=s.c.create('/apis/apiregistration.k8s.io/v1/apiservices',{'apiVersion':'apiregistration.k8s.io/v1','kind':'APIService','metadata':{'name':registration},'spec':{'group':group,'version':'v1','groupPriorityMinimum':100,'versionPriority':100,'insecureSkipTLSVerify':True,'service':{'namespace':s.ns,'name':'intentionally-removed-backend','port':443}}})
        assert s.c.request('DELETE','/api/v1/namespaces/'+namespace,{})[0] in (200,202)
        ns_path='/api/v1/namespaces/'+namespace
        def blocked():
            code,obj=s.c.request('GET',ns_path)
            return obj if code==200 and any(x['type']=='NamespaceDeletionDiscoveryFailure' and x['status']=='True' for x in obj.get('status',{}).get('conditions',[])) else False
        blocked_object=s.c.wait_controller(blocked,15,'native namespace discovery failure from unavailable registered API')
        assert blocked_object['metadata']['deletionTimestamp']
        path='/apis/apiregistration.k8s.io/v1/apiservices/'+registration
        result=student()(s.api,{'registration_path':path,'registration_uid':api_service['metadata']['uid'],'namespace_path':ns_path,'obsolete_backend_verified':True})
        assert result is True and s.c.request('GET',path)[0]==404
        assert all('/finalize' not in x['path'] and x['method']=='DELETE' for x in s.trace)
        s.c.wait_controller(lambda:s.c.request('GET',ns_path)[0]==404,15,'real namespace controller recovery after discovery repair')
        assert s.c.request('GET','/api/v1/namespaces/'+s.ns)[0]==200


def execute(case):
    globals()['check_'+case]()
    print('ALL_BATCH3_NATIVE_CONTROLLER_ASSERTIONS_PASSED',case)

title: 让真实binder按RWX与ROX模式选择兼容静态PV且不改旧卷
answer:
```python
def solve(api,case):
    obj={'apiVersion':'v1','kind':'PersistentVolumeClaim','metadata':{'name':case['name']},'spec':{'storageClassName':'','selector':{'matchLabels':{'pool':case['selector']}},'accessModes':case['modes'],'resources':{'requests':{'storage':case['request']}}}}
    code,created=api('POST','/api/v1/namespaces/'+case['namespace']+'/persistentvolumeclaims',obj);assert code==201,created
    return created['metadata']['uid']
```

## 原题原理与边界
RWO 表示通常一个节点读写，ROX 多节点只读，RWX 多节点读写；RWOP 对支持的 CSI 卷提供单 Pod 读写约束。RWO 不等于同节点只能一个 Pod，后端支持也不同；访问模式不自动为应用实现并发写锁。
review_note: 现有ID真实控制器合同；通过情况以配套平台runner报告的源码哈希为准，未通过时不据生成文件认定完成。
body:
## 初始环境
Linux非root2GiB/2CPU私有工作区，真实kube-apiserver/kube-controller-manager v1.34.1、etcd3.6.4、OpenSSL、kubectl。先用真实Quota.status协调、超额拒绝和Namespace清理确认控制器READY。限定控制器：Namespace、ResourceQuota、GC、ReplicaSet、Deployment、PV binder/protection、PVC protection、generic ephemeral。api(method,path,value=None,content_type="application/json")返回真实HTTP码及JSON；run(argv)返回退出码/stdout/stderr。

## 操作任务
solve(api,case)：为namespace/name创建PVC，storageClassName为空、selector.matchLabels.pool=selector、accessModes=modes、请求容量=request，返回UID。固定夹具分别给RWX和ROX两轮；每轮同时有标签匹配但仅RWO的错误PV及真正兼容PV，必须由真实binder选择兼容卷，不能修改PV能力标签、容量或访问模式。访问模式绑定匹配不等于运行时单写/多写隔离证明。

## 交付产物
task.py，仅修改该文件，不得改checks或伪造固定输入。

## 验收方法
固定夹具真实启动原生控制器并观察协调事实；四路平台判定和独立错误实现，READY后验证目标机制以及原身份/原对象保持；不把启动异常或外层超时计作有效错误拒绝。

## 能力边界
真实Kubernetes v1.34.1 API/etcd与指定controller-manager控制器；没有kubelet、scheduler、CNI、CSI和CRI，不写假Pod status。控制器产生的Pending Pod与真实API绑定/GC不证明容器运行、卷挂载、网络或业务健康。只用私有mTLS和临时数据，不连接外部集群，不读取或修改宿主默认身份/context。

"""Private native API fixture: real etcd and kube-apiserver, no kubeconfig changes."""
import base64
import contextlib
import http.client
import json
import os
import pathlib
import secrets
import socket
import ssl
import subprocess
import tempfile
import time


def free_port():
    with socket.socket() as sock:
        sock.bind(('127.0.0.1', 0))
        return sock.getsockname()[1]


class Cluster:
    def __init__(self, encryption=None):
        self.tmp = tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix='opsforge-pilot-k8s-')
        self.root = pathlib.Path(self.tmp.name)
        self.processes = []
        self.api_name = 'apiserver'
        self.encryption_path = self.root/'encryption.json'
        self.port, self.etcd_port, self.peer_port = free_port(), free_port(), free_port()
        self.url = 'https://127.0.0.1:' + str(self.port)
        self.run('openssl', 'ecparam', '-name', 'prime256v1', '-genkey', '-noout', '-out', str(self.root/'ca.key'))
        self.run('openssl', 'req', '-x509', '-new', '-key', str(self.root/'ca.key'), '-out', str(self.root/'ca.crt'), '-days', '1', '-subj', '/CN=opsforge-pilot-private-ca')
        self.identity('server', 'localhost', extensions='subjectAltName=IP:127.0.0.1\nextendedKeyUsage=serverAuth\n')
        self.identity('admin', 'opsforge-pilot-admin', 'system:masters')
        self.identity('learner', 'opsforge-pilot-user')
        (self.root/'encryption.json').write_text(json.dumps(encryption or {'apiVersion':'apiserver.config.k8s.io/v1','kind':'EncryptionConfiguration','resources':[{'resources':['secrets'],'providers':[{'identity':{}}]}]}))
        self.etcd = self.spawn('etcd', ['etcd', '--name=pilot', '--data-dir='+str(self.root/'data'), '--listen-client-urls=http://127.0.0.1:'+str(self.etcd_port), '--advertise-client-urls=http://127.0.0.1:'+str(self.etcd_port), '--listen-peer-urls=http://127.0.0.1:'+str(self.peer_port), '--initial-advertise-peer-urls=http://127.0.0.1:'+str(self.peer_port), '--initial-cluster=pilot=http://127.0.0.1:'+str(self.peer_port), '--quota-backend-bytes=67108864', '--logger=zap', '--log-level=error'])
        self.wait_etcd()
        self.start_api()

    def run(self, *args):
        return subprocess.run(args, check=True, capture_output=True, text=True, timeout=10)

    def identity(self, name, cn, org=None, extensions='extendedKeyUsage=clientAuth\n'):
        key, csr, crt = [self.root/(name+suffix) for suffix in ('.key','.csr','.crt')]
        self.run('openssl','ecparam','-name','prime256v1','-genkey','-noout','-out',str(key))
        self.run('openssl','req','-new','-key',str(key),'-out',str(csr),'-subj','/CN='+cn+('/O='+org if org else ''))
        ext=self.root/(name+'.ext');ext.write_text(extensions)
        self.run('openssl','x509','-req','-in',str(csr),'-CA',str(self.root/'ca.crt'),'-CAkey',str(self.root/'ca.key'),'-CAcreateserial','-out',str(crt),'-days','1','-extfile',str(ext))
        return name

    def spawn(self, name, args):
        handle=(self.root/(name+'.log')).open('ab')
        proc=subprocess.Popen(args,stdin=subprocess.DEVNULL,stdout=handle,stderr=handle)
        handle.close();self.processes.append(proc)
        return proc

    def wait_etcd(self):
        for _ in range(120):
            try:
                conn=http.client.HTTPConnection('127.0.0.1',self.etcd_port,timeout=.3)
                conn.request('GET','/health');response=conn.getresponse();response.read();conn.close()
                if response.status==200:return
            except OSError:pass
            if self.etcd.poll() is not None:raise RuntimeError((self.root/'etcd.log').read_text())
            time.sleep(.1)
        raise RuntimeError('real etcd startup timed out')

    def start_api(self):
        self.api=self.spawn(self.api_name,['kube-apiserver','--bind-address=127.0.0.1','--advertise-address=127.0.0.1','--secure-port='+str(self.port),'--etcd-servers=http://127.0.0.1:'+str(self.etcd_port),'--tls-cert-file='+str(self.root/'server.crt'),'--tls-private-key-file='+str(self.root/'server.key'),'--client-ca-file='+str(self.root/'ca.crt'),'--authorization-mode=Node,RBAC','--enable-admission-plugins=NodeRestriction','--disable-admission-plugins=ServiceAccount','--anonymous-auth=false','--service-cluster-ip-range=10.240.0.0/24','--service-account-issuer=https://kubernetes.default.svc','--service-account-signing-key-file='+str(self.root/'ca.key'),'--service-account-key-file='+str(self.root/'ca.key'),'--encryption-provider-config='+str(self.encryption_path),'--profiling=false','--v=0'])
        for _ in range(240):
            try:
                code,_=self.request('GET','/readyz')
                if code==200:return
            except (OSError,ssl.SSLError,http.client.HTTPException):pass
            if self.api.poll() is not None:raise RuntimeError((self.root/(self.api_name+'.log')).read_text()[-10000:])
            time.sleep(.1)
        raise RuntimeError('real kube-apiserver startup timed out')

    def restart_api(self, encryption):
        self.api.terminate();self.api.wait(timeout=10)
        self.encryption_path.write_text(json.dumps(encryption))
        self.start_api()

    def peer(self, encryption):
        peer=object.__new__(Cluster)
        peer.root=self.root
        peer.processes=[]
        peer.port=free_port();peer.etcd_port=self.etcd_port
        peer.url='https://127.0.0.1:'+str(peer.port)
        peer.api_name='apiserver-peer-'+secrets.token_hex(4)
        peer.encryption_path=self.root/(peer.api_name+'.json')
        peer.encryption_path.write_text(json.dumps(encryption))
        peer.start_api()
        return peer

    def config(self, identity='learner'):
        result={'server':self.url,'ca':str(self.root/'ca.crt'),'cert':str(self.root/(identity+'.crt')),'key':str(self.root/(identity+'.key'))}
        target=self.root/(identity+'-client.json');target.write_text(json.dumps(result))
        return str(target)

    def request(self, method, path, data=None, identity='admin', content_type='application/json'):
        context=ssl.create_default_context(cafile=str(self.root/'ca.crt'))
        context.load_cert_chain(str(self.root/(identity+'.crt')),str(self.root/(identity+'.key')))
        conn=http.client.HTTPSConnection('127.0.0.1',self.port,context=context,timeout=5)
        body=json.dumps(data).encode() if data is not None else None
        conn.request(method,path,body=body,headers={'Content-Type':content_type})
        response=conn.getresponse();raw=response.read();code=response.status;conn.close()
        try:return code,json.loads(raw)
        except ValueError:return code,raw.decode(errors='replace')

    def create(self, path, obj):
        code,value=self.request('POST',path,obj)
        assert code==201,(code,value)
        return value

    def namespace(self, name):
        return self.create('/api/v1/namespaces',{'apiVersion':'v1','kind':'Namespace','metadata':{'name':name}})

    def etcd_value(self, key):
        conn=http.client.HTTPConnection('127.0.0.1',self.etcd_port,timeout=5)
        conn.request('POST','/v3/kv/range',json.dumps({'key':base64.b64encode(key.encode()).decode()}),{'Content-Type':'application/json'})
        response=conn.getresponse();result=json.loads(response.read());conn.close()
        assert response.status==200,result
        return base64.b64decode(result['kvs'][0]['value'])

    def close(self):
        for proc in reversed(self.processes):
            if proc.poll() is None:
                proc.terminate()
                try:proc.wait(timeout=8)
                except subprocess.TimeoutExpired:proc.kill();proc.wait()
        if hasattr(self,'tmp'):self.tmp.cleanup()

    def __enter__(self):return self
    def __exit__(self,*args):self.close()


if __name__=='__main__':
    started=time.monotonic()
    with Cluster() as cluster:
        print(json.dumps({'ready':cluster.request('GET','/readyz'),'version':cluster.request('GET','/version'),'seconds':time.monotonic()-started}),flush=True)

"""Offline draft: real controller fixture, not yet executed or integrated.

Import alongside the approved native.py fixture after kube-controller-manager
v1.34.1 is available. No current-context, kubeconfig or host identity is read.
"""
import json
import os
import secrets
import shutil
import subprocess
import time
from native import Cluster


CONTROLLERS=(
    'namespace-controller','resourcequota-controller',
    'garbage-collector-controller','replicaset-controller',
    'deployment-controller','persistentvolume-binder-controller',
    'persistentvolume-protection-controller',
    'persistentvolumeclaim-protection-controller',
    'ephemeral-volume-controller',
)


class ControllerCluster(Cluster):
    def start_controllers(self, controllers=CONTROLLERS):
        tool=shutil.which('kube-controller-manager')
        if not tool:raise FileNotFoundError('required native kube-controller-manager unavailable')
        version=subprocess.check_output([tool,'--version'],text=True,timeout=4).strip()
        if version!='Kubernetes v1.34.1':raise RuntimeError('requires fixed v1.34.1 controller-manager: '+version)
        if os.geteuid()==0:raise RuntimeError('private controller fixture requires nonroot')
        config=self.root/'controller-private-kubeconfig.json'
        config.write_text(json.dumps({
            'apiVersion':'v1','kind':'Config',
            'clusters':[{'name':'private','cluster':{'server':self.url,'certificate-authority':str(self.root/'ca.crt')}}],
            'users':[{'name':'private-controller','user':{'client-certificate':str(self.root/'admin.crt'),'client-key':str(self.root/'admin.key')}}],
            'contexts':[{'name':'private-controller','context':{'cluster':'private','user':'private-controller'}}],
            'current-context':'private-controller',
        }))
        config.chmod(0o600)
        self.controller=self.spawn('controller-manager',[
            tool,'--kubeconfig='+str(config),
            '--authentication-kubeconfig='+str(config),
            '--authorization-kubeconfig='+str(config),
            '--controllers='+','.join(controllers),
            '--leader-elect=false','--use-service-account-credentials=false',
            '--secure-port=0','--bind-address=127.0.0.1',
            '--profiling=false','--kube-api-qps=50','--kube-api-burst=100',
            '--root-ca-file='+str(self.root/'ca.crt'),'--v=0',
        ])
        # No /healthz shortcut: readiness must be proved by a real controller
        # reconciling ResourceQuota status and Namespace finalization.
        canary='controller-canary-'+secrets.token_hex(5)
        self.namespace(canary)
        quota_path=f'/api/v1/namespaces/{canary}/resourcequotas/native-canary'
        self.create(f'/api/v1/namespaces/{canary}/resourcequotas',{
            'apiVersion':'v1','kind':'ResourceQuota','metadata':{'name':'native-canary'},
            'spec':{'hard':{'count/configmaps':'1'}},
        })
        def reconciled():
            code,obj=self.request('GET',quota_path)
            return code==200 and obj.get('status',{}).get('hard',{}).get('count/configmaps')=='1' and obj.get('status',{}).get('used',{}).get('count/configmaps')=='0'
        self.wait_controller(reconciled,20,'native ResourceQuota status reconciliation')
        self.create(f'/api/v1/namespaces/{canary}/configmaps',{'apiVersion':'v1','kind':'ConfigMap','metadata':{'name':'first'},'data':{'value':'controller-canary'}})
        code,_=self.request('POST',f'/api/v1/namespaces/{canary}/configmaps',{'apiVersion':'v1','kind':'ConfigMap','metadata':{'name':'must-deny'}})
        assert code==403,'real quota admission did not reject a second object'
        code,_=self.request('DELETE','/api/v1/namespaces/'+canary,{})
        assert code in (200,202)
        self.wait_controller(lambda:self.request('GET','/api/v1/namespaces/'+canary)[0]==404,20,'native Namespace controller finalization')
        print('NATIVE_CONTROLLER_MANAGER_READY',json.dumps({'version':version,'controllers':list(controllers),'quota_reconciled':True,'namespace_finalized':True}),flush=True)

    def wait_controller(self,predicate,seconds,label):
        deadline=time.monotonic()+seconds
        while time.monotonic()<deadline:
            for process in self.processes:
                if process.poll() is not None:
                    logs=(self.root/'controller-manager.log').read_text(errors='replace')[-6000:]
                    raise RuntimeError('private native component exited: '+logs)
            value=predicate()
            if value:return value
            time.sleep(.1)
        logs=(self.root/'controller-manager.log').read_text(errors='replace')[-6000:]
        raise TimeoutError(label+' timed out; native controller logs: '+logs)

"""Real controller reconciliation contracts; no Pod status is forged."""
import copy,json,pathlib,secrets,time,urllib.parse
import support
from controllers import ControllerCluster
from support import token,student,grant,configmap,pod,kubeconfig

support.Cluster=ControllerCluster


class Session(support.Session):
    def __enter__(self):
        super().__enter__()
        try:self.c.start_controllers()
        except BaseException:self.c.close();raise
        print('NATIVE_FIXTURE_READY:batch3-kubernetes-controllers',flush=True)
        return self


def get(c,path):
    code,obj=c.request('GET',path)
    assert code==200,(path,code,obj)
    return obj


def objects(c,ns,resource='pods',group='/api/v1'):
    return get(c,f'{group}/namespaces/{ns}/{resource}')['items']


def controller_uid(obj):
    return next((r['uid'] for r in obj['metadata'].get('ownerReferences',[]) if r.get('controller')),None)


def rs(c,ns,name=None,replicas=1,app=None,image='invalid.local/not-run:v1'):
    app=app or token('app');name=name or token('rs')
    return c.create(f'/apis/apps/v1/namespaces/{ns}/replicasets',{'apiVersion':'apps/v1','kind':'ReplicaSet','metadata':{'name':name},'spec':{'replicas':replicas,'selector':{'matchLabels':{'app':app}},'template':{'metadata':{'labels':{'app':app}},'spec':{'containers':[{'name':'main','image':image,'env':[{'name':'PRESERVE','value':token('env')}]}]}}}})


def deployment(c,ns,replicas=1,app=None):
    app=app or token('app')
    return c.create(f'/apis/apps/v1/namespaces/{ns}/deployments',{'apiVersion':'apps/v1','kind':'Deployment','metadata':{'name':token('deployment')},'spec':{'replicas':replicas,'selector':{'matchLabels':{'app':app}},'template':{'metadata':{'labels':{'app':app}},'spec':{'containers':[{'name':'main','image':'invalid.local/not-run:v1','env':[{'name':'PRESERVE','value':token('env')}]}]}}}})


def owned_pods(c,ns,uid,count):
    def found():
        result=[p for p in objects(c,ns) if controller_uid(p)==uid and not p['metadata'].get('deletionTimestamp')]
        return result if len(result)==count else False
    return c.wait_controller(found,12,'real ReplicaSet-created/adopted Pods')


def deployment_rs(c,ns,uid):
    def found():
        result=[r for r in objects(c,ns,'replicasets','/apis/apps/v1') if controller_uid(r)==uid]
        return result if result else False
    return c.wait_controller(found,12,'real Deployment-created ReplicaSet')


def pv(c,name,labels,modes=('ReadWriteOnce',),claim=None,path=None):
    spec={'capacity':{'storage':'16Mi'},'accessModes':list(modes),'persistentVolumeReclaimPolicy':'Retain','storageClassName':'','hostPath':{'path':str(path or c.root/('data-'+name)),'type':'DirectoryOrCreate'}}
    if claim:spec['claimRef']={'namespace':claim[0],'name':claim[1]}
    return c.create('/api/v1/persistentvolumes',{'apiVersion':'v1','kind':'PersistentVolume','metadata':{'name':name,'labels':labels},'spec':spec})


def bound(c,ns,name):
    path=f'/api/v1/namespaces/{ns}/persistentvolumeclaims/{name}'
    def ready():
        code,obj=c.request('GET',path)
        return obj if code==200 and obj.get('status',{}).get('phase')=='Bound' else False
    return c.wait_controller(ready,12,'native persistentvolume binder Bound')


def check_recreate():
    with Session() as s:
        dep=deployment(s.c,s.ns);replica=deployment_rs(s.c,s.ns,dep['metadata']['uid'])[0]
        managed=owned_pods(s.c,s.ns,replica['metadata']['uid'],1)[0]
        bare=pod(s.c,s.ns)
        cases={'bare_path':f'/api/v1/namespaces/{s.ns}/pods/'+bare['metadata']['name'],'bare_uid':bare['metadata']['uid'],'managed_path':f'/api/v1/namespaces/{s.ns}/pods/'+managed['metadata']['name'],'managed_uid':managed['metadata']['uid']}
        result=student()(s.api,cases)
        assert result is True and s.c.request('GET',cases['bare_path'])[0]==404
        replacement=owned_pods(s.c,s.ns,replica['metadata']['uid'],1)[0]
        assert replacement['metadata']['uid']!=managed['metadata']['uid']
        assert replacement['spec']==managed['spec']
        assert s.c.request('GET',cases['bare_path'])[0]==404
        assert get(s.c,f'/apis/apps/v1/namespaces/{s.ns}/deployments/'+dep['metadata']['name'])['metadata']['uid']==dep['metadata']['uid']
        assert all(x['method']=='DELETE' for x in s.trace) and len(s.trace)==2


def check_adoption():
    with Session() as s:
        for count in (1,2):
            app=token('shared');foreign_dep=deployment(s.c,s.ns,app=app)
            foreign_rs=deployment_rs(s.c,s.ns,foreign_dep['metadata']['uid'])[0]
            foreign=owned_pods(s.c,s.ns,foreign_rs['metadata']['uid'],1)[0]
            orphans=[s.c.create(f'/api/v1/namespaces/{s.ns}/pods',{'apiVersion':'v1','kind':'Pod','metadata':{'name':token('orphan'),'labels':{'app':app}},'spec':{'containers':[{'name':'main','image':'invalid.local/not-run:v1'}]}}) for _ in range(count)]
            name=token('adopter')
            result=student()(s.api,{'namespace':s.ns,'name':name,'app':app,'replicas':count,'image':'invalid.local/not-run:v1'})
            adopter=get(s.c,f'/apis/apps/v1/namespaces/{s.ns}/replicasets/{name}')
            assert result==adopter['metadata']['uid']
            assert adopter['spec']['replicas']==count and adopter['spec']['selector']['matchLabels']=={'app':app}
            adopted=owned_pods(s.c,s.ns,adopter['metadata']['uid'],count)
            assert {x['metadata']['uid']:x['spec'] for x in adopted}=={x['metadata']['uid']:x['spec'] for x in orphans},'must adopt original eligible Pods, not create replacements'
            original_foreign=get(s.c,f'/api/v1/namespaces/{s.ns}/pods/'+foreign['metadata']['name'])
            assert original_foreign['metadata']['uid']==foreign['metadata']['uid'] and controller_uid(original_foreign)==foreign_rs['metadata']['uid']


def check_orphan():
    with Session() as s:
        parent=rs(s.c,s.ns,replicas=2);original=owned_pods(s.c,s.ns,parent['metadata']['uid'],2)
        path=f'/apis/apps/v1/namespaces/{s.ns}/replicasets/'+parent['metadata']['name']
        result=student()(s.api,{'path':path,'uid':parent['metadata']['uid']})
        assert result is True
        s.c.wait_controller(lambda:s.c.request('GET',path)[0]==404,12,'native orphan deletion of ReplicaSet')
        for previous in original:
            code,current=s.c.request('GET',f'/api/v1/namespaces/{s.ns}/pods/'+previous['metadata']['name'])
            assert code==200 and current['metadata']['uid']==previous['metadata']['uid'],'orphan policy must preserve original Pods'
            assert controller_uid(current) is None and current['spec']==previous['spec']
        assert s.trace and s.trace[0]['method']=='DELETE'


def check_create_deployment():
    with Session() as s:
        config=s.c.root/'kubectl-private.json';kubeconfig(s.c,config,s.ns,context='private-operation')
        before=config.read_bytes();name=token('web');replicas=secrets.randbelow(3)+1
        uid=student()(s.runner,{'config':str(config),'context':'private-operation','namespace':s.ns,'name':name,'replicas':replicas,'image':'invalid.local/create-demo:v1'})
        dep=get(s.c,f'/apis/apps/v1/namespaces/{s.ns}/deployments/{name}')
        assert uid==dep['metadata']['uid'] and dep['spec']['replicas']==replicas
        child=deployment_rs(s.c,s.ns,uid)[0];pods=owned_pods(s.c,s.ns,child['metadata']['uid'],replicas)
        assert all(p['spec']['containers'][0]['image']=='invalid.local/create-demo:v1' for p in pods)
        assert all(p.get('status',{}).get('phase')=='Pending' for p in pods)
        assert config.read_bytes()==before and any('create' in r.get('args',[]) and 'deployment' in r['args'] for r in s.trace)


def check_counts():
    with Session() as s:
        count=secrets.randbelow(3)+2;parent=rs(s.c,s.ns,replicas=count)
        pods=owned_pods(s.c,s.ns,parent['metadata']['uid'],count)
        path=f'/apis/apps/v1/namespaces/{s.ns}/replicasets/'+parent['metadata']['name']
        s.c.wait_controller(lambda:get(s.c,path).get('status',{}).get('replicas')==count,12,'ReplicaSet native status reconciliation')
        result=student()(s.api,{'path':path,'pods_path':f'/api/v1/namespaces/{s.ns}/pods','owner_uid':parent['metadata']['uid']})
        assert result=={'desired':count,'current':count,'ready':0,'business_healthy':False}
        assert len(s.trace)>=2 and all(r['method']=='GET' for r in s.trace)
        assert all(p.get('status',{}).get('phase')=='Pending' for p in pods)


def check_revision():
    with Session() as s:
        dep=deployment(s.c,s.ns);old_rs=deployment_rs(s.c,s.ns,dep['metadata']['uid'])[0]
        owned_pods(s.c,s.ns,old_rs['metadata']['uid'],1)
        direct=rs(s.c,s.ns);direct_pod=owned_pods(s.c,s.ns,direct['metadata']['uid'],1)[0]
        dep_path=f'/apis/apps/v1/namespaces/{s.ns}/deployments/'+dep['metadata']['name']
        rs_path=f'/apis/apps/v1/namespaces/{s.ns}/replicasets/'+direct['metadata']['name']
        image='invalid.local/new-template:'+secrets.token_hex(4)
        result=student()(s.api,{'deployment':dep_path,'replicaset':rs_path,'image':image})
        assert result is True
        assert get(s.c,dep_path)['spec']['template']['spec']['containers'][0]['image']==image
        assert get(s.c,rs_path)['spec']['template']['spec']['containers'][0]['image']==image
        assert get(s.c,dep_path)['spec']['replicas']==dep['spec']['replicas'] and get(s.c,rs_path)['spec']['replicas']==direct['spec']['replicas'],'only change the template image, not replica counts'
        def revised():
            candidates=deployment_rs(s.c,s.ns,dep['metadata']['uid'])
            return next((x for x in candidates if x['metadata']['uid']!=old_rs['metadata']['uid'] and x['spec']['template']['spec']['containers'][0]['image']==image),False)
        new_rs=s.c.wait_controller(revised,12,'real Deployment new revision')
        new_pods=owned_pods(s.c,s.ns,new_rs['metadata']['uid'],1)
        assert new_pods[0]['spec']['containers'][0]['image']==image
        current=owned_pods(s.c,s.ns,direct['metadata']['uid'],1)[0]
        assert current['metadata']['uid']==direct_pod['metadata']['uid'] and current['spec']==direct_pod['spec'],'changing an RS template must not silently replace existing Pods'
        assert any(e['metadata']['annotations'].get('deployment.kubernetes.io/revision')=='2' for e in deployment_rs(s.c,s.ns,dep['metadata']['uid']))
        assert all('/pods/' not in r['path'] for r in s.trace),'do not manually replace Pods to simulate controller behavior'


def check_pvc():
    with Session() as s:
        name=token('claim');volume=token('pv')
        target=pv(s.c,volume,{'training':'private'},claim=(s.ns,name))
        request=str(secrets.randbelow(10)+2)+'Mi'
        uid=student()(s.api,{'namespace':s.ns,'name':name,'volume':volume,'request':request,'modes':['ReadWriteOnce']})
        submitted=get(s.c,f'/api/v1/namespaces/{s.ns}/persistentvolumeclaims/{name}')
        assert submitted['spec']['volumeName']==volume and submitted['spec']['resources']['requests']['storage']==request
        assert submitted['spec']['accessModes']==['ReadWriteOnce']
        claim=bound(s.c,s.ns,name)
        assert uid==claim['metadata']['uid'] and claim['spec']['volumeName']==volume
        actual=get(s.c,'/api/v1/persistentvolumes/'+volume)
        assert actual['status']['phase']=='Bound' and actual['spec']['claimRef']['uid']==uid
        assert actual['metadata']['uid']==target['metadata']['uid'] and claim['spec']['storageClassName']==''


def check_modes():
    with Session() as s:
        for mode in ('ReadWriteMany','ReadOnlyMany'):
            selector=token('pool');wrong=pv(s.c,token('rwo'),{'pool':selector})
            correct=pv(s.c,token('compatible'),{'pool':selector},modes=(mode,))
            name=token('claim');request=str(secrets.randbelow(10)+2)+'Mi'
            uid=student()(s.api,{'namespace':s.ns,'name':name,'selector':selector,'modes':[mode],'request':request})
            submitted=get(s.c,f'/api/v1/namespaces/{s.ns}/persistentvolumeclaims/{name}')
            assert submitted['spec']['accessModes']==[mode] and submitted['spec']['resources']['requests']['storage']==request
            claim=bound(s.c,s.ns,name)
            assert uid==claim['metadata']['uid'] and claim['spec']['volumeName']==correct['metadata']['name']
            untouched=get(s.c,'/api/v1/persistentvolumes/'+wrong['metadata']['name'])
            assert untouched['spec']==wrong['spec'] and not untouched['spec'].get('claimRef')
        print('NATIVE_BINDER_ACCESS_MODE_COMPATIBILITY; NO_MOUNT_OR_IO_ISOLATION_CLAIM')


def check_retain():
    with Session() as s:
        data=s.c.root/'retained-data';data.mkdir();marker=data/'payload';payload=secrets.token_bytes(61);marker.write_bytes(payload)
        claim_name=token('claim');volume=token('retained')
        target=pv(s.c,volume,{'owner':token('owner')},claim=(s.ns,claim_name),path=data)
        s.c.create(f'/api/v1/namespaces/{s.ns}/persistentvolumeclaims',{'apiVersion':'v1','kind':'PersistentVolumeClaim','metadata':{'name':claim_name},'spec':{'storageClassName':'','volumeName':volume,'accessModes':['ReadWriteOnce'],'resources':{'requests':{'storage':'8Mi'}}}})
        claim=bound(s.c,s.ns,claim_name)
        case={'path':f'/api/v1/namespaces/{s.ns}/persistentvolumeclaims/{claim_name}','uid':claim['metadata']['uid']}
        assert student()(s.api,case) is True
        assert len(s.trace)==1 and s.trace[0]['method']=='DELETE' and s.trace[0]['path']==case['path'] and s.trace[0]['status'] in (200,202),'must issue the actual UID-protected PVC delete'
        s.c.wait_controller(lambda:s.c.request('GET',case['path'])[0]==404,12,'PVC protection controller release')
        s.c.wait_controller(lambda:get(s.c,'/api/v1/persistentvolumes/'+volume).get('status',{}).get('phase')=='Released',12,'PV binder Retain release')
        current=get(s.c,'/api/v1/persistentvolumes/'+volume)
        assert current['metadata']['uid']==target['metadata']['uid'] and current['spec']['persistentVolumeReclaimPolicy']=='Retain'
        assert current['spec']['claimRef']['uid']==claim['metadata']['uid'],'do not clear old data ownership automatically'
        assert marker.read_bytes()==payload and len(s.trace)==1 and s.trace[0]['method']=='DELETE'


def check_ephemeral():
    with Session() as s:
        old=s.c.create(f'/api/v1/namespaces/{s.ns}/persistentvolumeclaims',{'apiVersion':'v1','kind':'PersistentVolumeClaim','metadata':{'name':token('unrelated')},'spec':{'storageClassName':'','accessModes':['ReadWriteOnce'],'resources':{'requests':{'storage':'1Mi'}}}})
        name=token('ephemeral');volume='scratch'
        document={'apiVersion':'v1','kind':'Pod','metadata':{'name':name},'spec':{'containers':[{'name':'main','image':'invalid.local/no-runtime','volumeMounts':[{'name':volume,'mountPath':'/scratch'}]}],'volumes':[{'name':volume,'ephemeral':{'volumeClaimTemplate':{'spec':{'storageClassName':'','accessModes':['ReadWriteOnce'],'resources':{'requests':{'storage':'1Mi'}}}}}}]}}
        obj=s.c.create(f'/api/v1/namespaces/{s.ns}/pods',document)
        claim_path=f'/api/v1/namespaces/{s.ns}/persistentvolumeclaims/{name}-{volume}'
        def created():
            code,value=s.c.request('GET',claim_path)
            return value if code==200 else False
        claim=s.c.wait_controller(created,12,'native ephemeral volume controller-created PVC')
        assert controller_uid(claim)==obj['metadata']['uid']
        path=f'/api/v1/namespaces/{s.ns}/pods/{name}'
        assert student()(s.api,{'path':path,'uid':obj['metadata']['uid']}) is True
        assert s.c.request('GET',path)[0]==404
        s.c.wait_controller(lambda:s.c.request('GET',claim_path)[0]==404,12,'native GC cleanup of generic ephemeral PVC')
        assert get(s.c,f'/api/v1/namespaces/{s.ns}/persistentvolumeclaims/'+old['metadata']['name'])['metadata']['uid']==old['metadata']['uid']
        assert len(s.trace)==1 and s.trace[0]['method']=='DELETE' and '/pods/' in s.trace[0]['path']


def check_quota():
    with Session() as s:
        qname=token('quota');path=f'/api/v1/namespaces/{s.ns}/resourcequotas/{qname}'
        quota=s.c.create(f'/api/v1/namespaces/{s.ns}/resourcequotas',{'apiVersion':'v1','kind':'ResourceQuota','metadata':{'name':qname},'spec':{'hard':{'count/configmaps':'1','count/secrets':'2'}}})
        s.c.wait_controller(lambda:get(s.c,path).get('status',{}).get('hard',{}).get('count/configmaps')=='1',12,'quota initial hard reconciliation')
        old=configmap(s.c,s.ns)
        request={'apiVersion':'v1','kind':'ConfigMap','metadata':{'name':token('new')},'data':{'value':token('payload')}}
        denied,_=s.c.request('POST',f'/api/v1/namespaces/{s.ns}/configmaps',request);assert denied==403
        limit=secrets.randbelow(3)+2
        result=student()(s.api,{'path':path,'collection':f'/api/v1/namespaces/{s.ns}/configmaps','document':request,'new_limit':str(limit)})
        assert result is True
        current=get(s.c,path);assert current['spec']['hard']=={'count/configmaps':str(limit),'count/secrets':'2'}
        assert get(s.c,f'/api/v1/namespaces/{s.ns}/configmaps/'+old['metadata']['name'])==old
        assert get(s.c,f'/api/v1/namespaces/{s.ns}/configmaps/'+request['metadata']['name'])['data']==request['data']
        s.c.wait_controller(lambda:get(s.c,path).get('status',{}).get('used',{}).get('count/configmaps')=='2',12,'quota actual used accounting')
        for _ in range(limit-2):configmap(s.c,s.ns)
        code,_=s.c.request('POST',f'/api/v1/namespaces/{s.ns}/configmaps',{'apiVersion':'v1','kind':'ConfigMap','metadata':{'name':token('must-deny')}})
        assert code==403,'new quota must remain enforced, not removed or bypassed'
        assert all('/status' not in x['path'] and x['method']!='DELETE' for x in s.trace)


def check_namespace_discovery():
    with Session() as s:
        namespace=token('terminating');s.c.namespace(namespace)
        group=token('removed')+'.example.com';registration='v1.'+group
        api_service=s.c.create('/apis/apiregistration.k8s.io/v1/apiservices',{'apiVersion':'apiregistration.k8s.io/v1','kind':'APIService','metadata':{'name':registration},'spec':{'group':group,'version':'v1','groupPriorityMinimum':100,'versionPriority':100,'insecureSkipTLSVerify':True,'service':{'namespace':s.ns,'name':'intentionally-removed-backend','port':443}}})
        assert s.c.request('DELETE','/api/v1/namespaces/'+namespace,{})[0] in (200,202)
        ns_path='/api/v1/namespaces/'+namespace
        def blocked():
            code,obj=s.c.request('GET',ns_path)
            return obj if code==200 and any(x['type']=='NamespaceDeletionDiscoveryFailure' and x['status']=='True' for x in obj.get('status',{}).get('conditions',[])) else False
        blocked_object=s.c.wait_controller(blocked,15,'native namespace discovery failure from unavailable registered API')
        assert blocked_object['metadata']['deletionTimestamp']
        path='/apis/apiregistration.k8s.io/v1/apiservices/'+registration
        result=student()(s.api,{'registration_path':path,'registration_uid':api_service['metadata']['uid'],'namespace_path':ns_path,'obsolete_backend_verified':True})
        assert result is True and s.c.request('GET',path)[0]==404
        assert all('/finalize' not in x['path'] and x['method']=='DELETE' for x in s.trace)
        s.c.wait_controller(lambda:s.c.request('GET',ns_path)[0]==404,15,'real namespace controller recovery after discovery repair')
        assert s.c.request('GET','/api/v1/namespaces/'+s.ns)[0]==200


def execute(case):
    globals()['check_'+case]()
    print('ALL_BATCH3_NATIVE_CONTROLLER_ASSERTIONS_PASSED',case)

"""Private native API fixture: real etcd and kube-apiserver, no kubeconfig changes."""
import base64
import contextlib
import http.client
import json
import os
import pathlib
import secrets
import socket
import ssl
import subprocess
import tempfile
import time


def free_port():
    with socket.socket() as sock:
        sock.bind(('127.0.0.1', 0))
        return sock.getsockname()[1]


class Cluster:
    def __init__(self, encryption=None):
        self.tmp = tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix='opsforge-pilot-k8s-')
        self.root = pathlib.Path(self.tmp.name)
        self.processes = []
        self.api_name = 'apiserver'
        self.encryption_path = self.root/'encryption.json'
        self.port, self.etcd_port, self.peer_port = free_port(), free_port(), free_port()
        self.url = 'https://127.0.0.1:' + str(self.port)
        self.run('openssl', 'ecparam', '-name', 'prime256v1', '-genkey', '-noout', '-out', str(self.root/'ca.key'))
        self.run('openssl', 'req', '-x509', '-new', '-key', str(self.root/'ca.key'), '-out', str(self.root/'ca.crt'), '-days', '1', '-subj', '/CN=opsforge-pilot-private-ca')
        self.identity('server', 'localhost', extensions='subjectAltName=IP:127.0.0.1\nextendedKeyUsage=serverAuth\n')
        self.identity('admin', 'opsforge-pilot-admin', 'system:masters')
        self.identity('learner', 'opsforge-pilot-user')
        (self.root/'encryption.json').write_text(json.dumps(encryption or {'apiVersion':'apiserver.config.k8s.io/v1','kind':'EncryptionConfiguration','resources':[{'resources':['secrets'],'providers':[{'identity':{}}]}]}))
        self.etcd = self.spawn('etcd', ['etcd', '--name=pilot', '--data-dir='+str(self.root/'data'), '--listen-client-urls=http://127.0.0.1:'+str(self.etcd_port), '--advertise-client-urls=http://127.0.0.1:'+str(self.etcd_port), '--listen-peer-urls=http://127.0.0.1:'+str(self.peer_port), '--initial-advertise-peer-urls=http://127.0.0.1:'+str(self.peer_port), '--initial-cluster=pilot=http://127.0.0.1:'+str(self.peer_port), '--quota-backend-bytes=67108864', '--logger=zap', '--log-level=error'])
        self.wait_etcd()
        self.start_api()

    def run(self, *args):
        return subprocess.run(args, check=True, capture_output=True, text=True, timeout=10)

    def identity(self, name, cn, org=None, extensions='extendedKeyUsage=clientAuth\n'):
        key, csr, crt = [self.root/(name+suffix) for suffix in ('.key','.csr','.crt')]
        self.run('openssl','ecparam','-name','prime256v1','-genkey','-noout','-out',str(key))
        self.run('openssl','req','-new','-key',str(key),'-out',str(csr),'-subj','/CN='+cn+('/O='+org if org else ''))
        ext=self.root/(name+'.ext');ext.write_text(extensions)
        self.run('openssl','x509','-req','-in',str(csr),'-CA',str(self.root/'ca.crt'),'-CAkey',str(self.root/'ca.key'),'-CAcreateserial','-out',str(crt),'-days','1','-extfile',str(ext))
        return name

    def spawn(self, name, args):
        handle=(self.root/(name+'.log')).open('ab')
        proc=subprocess.Popen(args,stdin=subprocess.DEVNULL,stdout=handle,stderr=handle)
        handle.close();self.processes.append(proc)
        return proc

    def wait_etcd(self):
        for _ in range(120):
            try:
                conn=http.client.HTTPConnection('127.0.0.1',self.etcd_port,timeout=.3)
                conn.request('GET','/health');response=conn.getresponse();response.read();conn.close()
                if response.status==200:return
            except OSError:pass
            if self.etcd.poll() is not None:raise RuntimeError((self.root/'etcd.log').read_text())
            time.sleep(.1)
        raise RuntimeError('real etcd startup timed out')

    def start_api(self):
        self.api=self.spawn(self.api_name,['kube-apiserver','--bind-address=127.0.0.1','--advertise-address=127.0.0.1','--secure-port='+str(self.port),'--etcd-servers=http://127.0.0.1:'+str(self.etcd_port),'--tls-cert-file='+str(self.root/'server.crt'),'--tls-private-key-file='+str(self.root/'server.key'),'--client-ca-file='+str(self.root/'ca.crt'),'--authorization-mode=Node,RBAC','--enable-admission-plugins=NodeRestriction','--disable-admission-plugins=ServiceAccount','--anonymous-auth=false','--service-cluster-ip-range=10.240.0.0/24','--service-account-issuer=https://kubernetes.default.svc','--service-account-signing-key-file='+str(self.root/'ca.key'),'--service-account-key-file='+str(self.root/'ca.key'),'--encryption-provider-config='+str(self.encryption_path),'--profiling=false','--v=0'])
        for _ in range(240):
            try:
                code,_=self.request('GET','/readyz')
                if code==200:return
            except (OSError,ssl.SSLError,http.client.HTTPException):pass
            if self.api.poll() is not None:raise RuntimeError((self.root/(self.api_name+'.log')).read_text()[-10000:])
            time.sleep(.1)
        raise RuntimeError('real kube-apiserver startup timed out')

    def restart_api(self, encryption):
        self.api.terminate();self.api.wait(timeout=10)
        self.encryption_path.write_text(json.dumps(encryption))
        self.start_api()

    def peer(self, encryption):
        peer=object.__new__(Cluster)
        peer.root=self.root
        peer.processes=[]
        peer.port=free_port();peer.etcd_port=self.etcd_port
        peer.url='https://127.0.0.1:'+str(peer.port)
        peer.api_name='apiserver-peer-'+secrets.token_hex(4)
        peer.encryption_path=self.root/(peer.api_name+'.json')
        peer.encryption_path.write_text(json.dumps(encryption))
        peer.start_api()
        return peer

    def config(self, identity='learner'):
        result={'server':self.url,'ca':str(self.root/'ca.crt'),'cert':str(self.root/(identity+'.crt')),'key':str(self.root/(identity+'.key'))}
        target=self.root/(identity+'-client.json');target.write_text(json.dumps(result))
        return str(target)

    def request(self, method, path, data=None, identity='admin', content_type='application/json'):
        context=ssl.create_default_context(cafile=str(self.root/'ca.crt'))
        context.load_cert_chain(str(self.root/(identity+'.crt')),str(self.root/(identity+'.key')))
        conn=http.client.HTTPSConnection('127.0.0.1',self.port,context=context,timeout=5)
        body=json.dumps(data).encode() if data is not None else None
        conn.request(method,path,body=body,headers={'Content-Type':content_type})
        response=conn.getresponse();raw=response.read();code=response.status;conn.close()
        try:return code,json.loads(raw)
        except ValueError:return code,raw.decode(errors='replace')

    def create(self, path, obj):
        code,value=self.request('POST',path,obj)
        assert code==201,(code,value)
        return value

    def namespace(self, name):
        return self.create('/api/v1/namespaces',{'apiVersion':'v1','kind':'Namespace','metadata':{'name':name}})

    def etcd_value(self, key):
        conn=http.client.HTTPConnection('127.0.0.1',self.etcd_port,timeout=5)
        conn.request('POST','/v3/kv/range',json.dumps({'key':base64.b64encode(key.encode()).decode()}),{'Content-Type':'application/json'})
        response=conn.getresponse();result=json.loads(response.read());conn.close()
        assert response.status==200,result
        return base64.b64decode(result['kvs'][0]['value'])

    def close(self):
        for proc in reversed(self.processes):
            if proc.poll() is None:
                proc.terminate()
                try:proc.wait(timeout=8)
                except subprocess.TimeoutExpired:proc.kill();proc.wait()
        if hasattr(self,'tmp'):self.tmp.cleanup()

    def __enter__(self):return self
    def __exit__(self,*args):self.close()


if __name__=='__main__':
    started=time.monotonic()
    with Cluster() as cluster:
        print(json.dumps({'ready':cluster.request('GET','/readyz'),'version':cluster.request('GET','/version'),'seconds':time.monotonic()-started}),flush=True)

v1.34.1 is available. No current-context, kubeconfig or host identity is read.
"""
import json
import os
import secrets
import shutil
import subprocess
import time
from native import Cluster


CONTROLLERS=(
    'namespace-controller','resourcequota-controller',
    'garbage-collector-controller','replicaset-controller',
    'deployment-controller','persistentvolume-binder-controller',
    'persistentvolume-protection-controller',
    'persistentvolumeclaim-protection-controller',
    'ephemeral-volume-controller',
)


class ControllerCluster(Cluster):
    def start_controllers(self, controllers=CONTROLLERS):
        tool=shutil.which('kube-controller-manager')
        if not tool:raise FileNotFoundError('required native kube-controller-manager unavailable')
        version=subprocess.check_output([tool,'--version'],text=True,timeout=4).strip()
        if version!='Kubernetes v1.34.1':raise RuntimeError('requires fixed v1.34.1 controller-manager: '+version)
        if os.geteuid()==0:raise RuntimeError('private controller fixture requires nonroot')
        config=self.root/'controller-private-kubeconfig.json'
        config.write_text(json.dumps({
            'apiVersion':'v1','kind':'Config',
            'clusters':[{'name':'private','cluster':{'server':self.url,'certificate-authority':str(self.root/'ca.crt')}}],
            'users':[{'name':'private-controller','user':{'client-certificate':str(self.root/'admin.crt'),'client-key':str(self.root/'admin.key')}}],
            'contexts':[{'name':'private-controller','context':{'cluster':'private','user':'private-controller'}}],
            'current-context':'private-controller',
        }))
        config.chmod(0o600)
        self.controller=self.spawn('controller-manager',[
            tool,'--kubeconfig='+str(config),
            '--authentication-kubeconfig='+str(config),
            '--authorization-kubeconfig='+str(config),
            '--controllers='+','.join(controllers),
            '--leader-elect=false','--use-service-account-credentials=false',
            '--secure-port=0','--bind-address=127.0.0.1',
            '--profiling=false','--kube-api-qps=50','--kube-api-burst=100',
            '--root-ca-file='+str(self.root/'ca.crt'),'--v=0',
        ])
        # No /healthz shortcut: readiness must be proved by a real controller
        # reconciling ResourceQuota status and Namespace finalization.
        canary='controller-canary-'+secrets.token_hex(5)
        self.namespace(canary)
        quota_path=f'/api/v1/namespaces/{canary}/resourcequotas/native-canary'
        self.create(f'/api/v1/namespaces/{canary}/resourcequotas',{
            'apiVersion':'v1','kind':'ResourceQuota','metadata':{'name':'native-canary'},
            'spec':{'hard':{'count/configmaps':'1'}},
        })
        def reconciled():
            code,obj=self.request('GET',quota_path)
            return code==200 and obj.get('status',{}).get('hard',{}).get('count/configmaps')=='1' and obj.get('status',{}).get('used',{}).get('count/configmaps')=='0'
        self.wait_controller(reconciled,20,'native ResourceQuota status reconciliation')
        self.create(f'/api/v1/namespaces/{canary}/configmaps',{'apiVersion':'v1','kind':'ConfigMap','metadata':{'name':'first'},'data':{'value':'controller-canary'}})
        code,_=self.request('POST',f'/api/v1/namespaces/{canary}/configmaps',{'apiVersion':'v1','kind':'ConfigMap','metadata':{'name':'must-deny'}})
        assert code==403,'real quota admission did not reject a second object'
        code,_=self.request('DELETE','/api/v1/namespaces/'+canary,{})
        assert code in (200,202)
        self.wait_controller(lambda:self.request('GET','/api/v1/namespaces/'+canary)[0]==404,20,'native Namespace controller finalization')
        print('NATIVE_CONTROLLER_MANAGER_READY',json.dumps({'version':version,'controllers':list(controllers),'quota_reconciled':True,'namespace_finalized':True}),flush=True)

    def wait_controller(self,predicate,seconds,label):
        deadline=time.monotonic()+seconds
        while time.monotonic()<deadline:
            for process in self.processes:
                if process.poll() is not None:
                    logs=(self.root/'controller-manager.log').read_text(errors='replace')[-6000:]
                    raise RuntimeError('private native component exited: '+logs)
            value=predicate()
            if value:return value
            time.sleep(.1)
        logs=(self.root/'controller-manager.log').read_text(errors='replace')[-6000:]
        raise TimeoutError(label+' timed out; native controller logs: '+logs)

"""Real controller reconciliation contracts; no Pod status is forged."""
import copy,json,pathlib,secrets,time,urllib.parse
import support
from controllers import ControllerCluster
from support import token,student,grant,configmap,pod,kubeconfig

support.Cluster=ControllerCluster


class Session(support.Session):
    def __enter__(self):
        super().__enter__()
        try:self.c.start_controllers()
        except BaseException:self.c.close();raise
        print('NATIVE_FIXTURE_READY:batch3-kubernetes-controllers',flush=True)
        return self


def get(c,path):
    code,obj=c.request('GET',path)
    assert code==200,(path,code,obj)
    return obj


def objects(c,ns,resource='pods',group='/api/v1'):
    return get(c,f'{group}/namespaces/{ns}/{resource}')['items']


def controller_uid(obj):
    return next((r['uid'] for r in obj['metadata'].get('ownerReferences',[]) if r.get('controller')),None)


def rs(c,ns,name=None,replicas=1,app=None,image='invalid.local/not-run:v1'):
    app=app or token('app');name=name or token('rs')
    return c.create(f'/apis/apps/v1/namespaces/{ns}/replicasets',{'apiVersion':'apps/v1','kind':'ReplicaSet','metadata':{'name':name},'spec':{'replicas':replicas,'selector':{'matchLabels':{'app':app}},'template':{'metadata':{'labels':{'app':app}},'spec':{'containers':[{'name':'main','image':image,'env':[{'name':'PRESERVE','value':token('env')}]}]}}}})


def deployment(c,ns,replicas=1,app=None):
    app=app or token('app')
    return c.create(f'/apis/apps/v1/namespaces/{ns}/deployments',{'apiVersion':'apps/v1','kind':'Deployment','metadata':{'name':token('deployment')},'spec':{'replicas':replicas,'selector':{'matchLabels':{'app':app}},'template':{'metadata':{'labels':{'app':app}},'spec':{'containers':[{'name':'main','image':'invalid.local/not-run:v1','env':[{'name':'PRESERVE','value':token('env')}]}]}}}})


def owned_pods(c,ns,uid,count):
    def found():
        result=[p for p in objects(c,ns) if controller_uid(p)==uid and not p['metadata'].get('deletionTimestamp')]
        return result if len(result)==count else False
    return c.wait_controller(found,12,'real ReplicaSet-created/adopted Pods')


def deployment_rs(c,ns,uid):
    def found():
        result=[r for r in objects(c,ns,'replicasets','/apis/apps/v1') if controller_uid(r)==uid]
        return result if result else False
    return c.wait_controller(found,12,'real Deployment-created ReplicaSet')


def pv(c,name,labels,modes=('ReadWriteOnce',),claim=None,path=None):
    spec={'capacity':{'storage':'16Mi'},'accessModes':list(modes),'persistentVolumeReclaimPolicy':'Retain','storageClassName':'','hostPath':{'path':str(path or c.root/('data-'+name)),'type':'DirectoryOrCreate'}}
    if claim:spec['claimRef']={'namespace':claim[0],'name':claim[1]}
    return c.create('/api/v1/persistentvolumes',{'apiVersion':'v1','kind':'PersistentVolume','metadata':{'name':name,'labels':labels},'spec':spec})


def bound(c,ns,name):
    path=f'/api/v1/namespaces/{ns}/persistentvolumeclaims/{name}'
    def ready():
        code,obj=c.request('GET',path)
        return obj if code==200 and obj.get('status',{}).get('phase')=='Bound' else False
    return c.wait_controller(ready,12,'native persistentvolume binder Bound')


def check_recreate():
    with Session() as s:
        dep=deployment(s.c,s.ns);replica=deployment_rs(s.c,s.ns,dep['metadata']['uid'])[0]
        managed=owned_pods(s.c,s.ns,replica['metadata']['uid'],1)[0]
        bare=pod(s.c,s.ns)
        cases={'bare_path':f'/api/v1/namespaces/{s.ns}/pods/'+bare['metadata']['name'],'bare_uid':bare['metadata']['uid'],'managed_path':f'/api/v1/namespaces/{s.ns}/pods/'+managed['metadata']['name'],'managed_uid':managed['metadata']['uid']}
        result=student()(s.api,cases)
        assert result is True and s.c.request('GET',cases['bare_path'])[0]==404
        replacement=owned_pods(s.c,s.ns,replica['metadata']['uid'],1)[0]
        assert replacement['metadata']['uid']!=managed['metadata']['uid']
        assert replacement['spec']==managed['spec']
        assert s.c.request('GET',cases['bare_path'])[0]==404
        assert get(s.c,f'/apis/apps/v1/namespaces/{s.ns}/deployments/'+dep['metadata']['name'])['metadata']['uid']==dep['metadata']['uid']
        assert all(x['method']=='DELETE' for x in s.trace) and len(s.trace)==2


def check_adoption():
    with Session() as s:
        for count in (1,2):
            app=token('shared');foreign_dep=deployment(s.c,s.ns,app=app)
            foreign_rs=deployment_rs(s.c,s.ns,foreign_dep['metadata']['uid'])[0]
            foreign=owned_pods(s.c,s.ns,foreign_rs['metadata']['uid'],1)[0]
            orphans=[s.c.create(f'/api/v1/namespaces/{s.ns}/pods',{'apiVersion':'v1','kind':'Pod','metadata':{'name':token('orphan'),'labels':{'app':app}},'spec':{'containers':[{'name':'main','image':'invalid.local/not-run:v1'}]}}) for _ in range(count)]
            name=token('adopter')
            result=student()(s.api,{'namespace':s.ns,'name':name,'app':app,'replicas':count,'image':'invalid.local/not-run:v1'})
            adopter=get(s.c,f'/apis/apps/v1/namespaces/{s.ns}/replicasets/{name}')
            assert result==adopter['metadata']['uid']
            assert adopter['spec']['replicas']==count and adopter['spec']['selector']['matchLabels']=={'app':app}
            adopted=owned_pods(s.c,s.ns,adopter['metadata']['uid'],count)
            assert {x['metadata']['uid']:x['spec'] for x in adopted}=={x['metadata']['uid']:x['spec'] for x in orphans},'must adopt original eligible Pods, not create replacements'
            original_foreign=get(s.c,f'/api/v1/namespaces/{s.ns}/pods/'+foreign['metadata']['name'])
            assert original_foreign['metadata']['uid']==foreign['metadata']['uid'] and controller_uid(original_foreign)==foreign_rs['metadata']['uid']


def check_orphan():
    with Session() as s:
        parent=rs(s.c,s.ns,replicas=2);original=owned_pods(s.c,s.ns,parent['metadata']['uid'],2)
        path=f'/apis/apps/v1/namespaces/{s.ns}/replicasets/'+parent['metadata']['name']

def check_create_deployment():
    with Session() as s:
        config=s.c.root/'kubectl-private.json';kubeconfig(s.c,config,s.ns,context='private-operation')
        before=config.read_bytes();name=token('web');replicas=secrets.randbelow(3)+1

    with Session() as s:
        count=secrets.randbelow(3)+2;parent=rs(s.c,s.ns,replicas=count)
        pods=owned_pods(s.c,s.ns,parent['metadata']['uid'],count)

        result=student()(s.api,{'path':path,'pods_path':f'/api/v1/namespaces/{s.ns}/pods','owner_uid':parent['metadata']['uid']})
        assert result=={'desired':count,'current':count,'ready':0,'business_healthy':False}

def check_revision():
    with Session() as s:
        dep=deployment(s.c,s.ns);old_rs=deployment_rs(s.c,s.ns,dep['metadata']['uid'])[0]
        owned_pods(s.c,s.ns,old_rs['metadata']['uid'],1)
        direct=rs(s.c,s.ns);direct_pod=owned_pods(s.c,s.ns,direct['metadata']['uid'],1)[0]
        dep_path=f'/apis/apps/v1/namespaces/{s.ns}/deployments/'+dep['metadata']['name']

def check_namespace_discovery():
    with Session() as s:
        namespace=token('terminating');s.c.namespace(namespace)

        api_service=s.c.create('/apis/apiregistration.k8s.io/v1/apiservices',{'apiVersion':'apiregistration.k8s.io/v1','kind':'APIService','metadata':{'name':registration},'spec':{'group':group,'version':'v1','groupPriorityMinimum':100,'versionPriority':100,'insecureSkipTLSVerify':True,'service':{'namespace':s.ns,'name':'intentionally-removed-backend','port':443}}})

        assert all('/finalize' not in x['path'] and x['method']=='DELETE' for x in s.trace)
        s.c.wait_controller(lambda:s.c.request('GET',ns_path)[0]==404,15,'real namespace controller recovery after discovery repair')
        assert s.c.request('GET','/api/v1/namespaces/'+s.ns)[0]==200


def execute(case):
    globals()['check_'+case]()
    print('ALL_BATCH3_NATIVE_CONTROLLER_ASSERTIONS_PASSED',case)

## 原题原理与边界
临时卷生命周期通常与 Pod 绑定，适合缓存、临时工作目录或注入数据；容器重启和 Pod 删除对不同卷的影响不同。不能把需跨 Pod 重建保存的数据放入临时卷后期待永久保留。

body:
## 初始环境
